title: [ALAppExtensions #30245][W1][Report][1701][Deferral Summary - Sales] Add integration event OnBeforeReturnSalesDocTypeString in ReturnSalesDocTypeString Procedure
summary: An integration event was added to the ReturnSalesDocTypeString procedure in report 1701 so that extensions can override the document type text shown in the Deferral Summary - Sales report.
key_points: New IsHandled-style event allows subscribers to replace hardcoded document type text
Procedure is local with case statement mapping each type to text
Default behavior unchanged when no subscriber handles the event
Named return parameter added for clean event override capability
quote: Adds an IsHandled-style event to `ReturnSalesDocTypeString` so extensions can replace the document type text the report shows.
